---

; upstream uses unsorted directory order
extraction.retail_policy: data/tau2/domains/retail/policy.md bytes, decoded as UTF-8, unmodified

interpretation: cl100k_base is the tokenizer installed tiktoken maps to text-embedding-3-small, so those counts are exact embedding-input counts for this extracted text. o200k_base counts are tokenizer-specific measurements only; they are not gpt-6-luna or claude-haiku-5-5 counts, and prompt framing, tool schemas and message overhead are excluded.

model_counting.claude-haiku-5-5: provider endpoint POST /v1/messages/count_tokens (request-level estimate; requires Anthropic credentials); not run by this offline command
model_counting.gpt-6-luna: provider endpoint POST /v1/responses/input_tokens (openai SDK responses.input_tokens.count); requires an OpenAI API key; not run by this command and not substituted by o200k_base
model_counting.text-embedding-3-small: local tokenizer: tiktoken model mapping (exact tokenizer for embedding input)
